title: Comments of John A. Padron in opposition to the Cook Inlet Subsea-Compute and Infrastructure Hub Project under P-15423.

documents.name: DocBatch261109-0019.pdf
documents.text:
ORIGINAL
Date




United States of America

Federal Energy Regulatory Commission

Deep Green Cook Inlet SN, LLC                    Docket #P.15423-000

                                                 Project No. 15423-000




To: Debbie Anne A. Reese, Secretary, Federal Energy Regulatory Commission

888 First St. N.E., Room 1A, Washington, DC 20426



I protest this Cook Inlet Subsea-Compute and Infrastructure HUB Project (Deep Green
Project) to be located in the Upper Cook Inlet, East Foreland Corridor, Kenai Peninsula
Borough, Alaska.

I think a data center in an important water way for marine life including Beluga Whales that
are endangered is a terrible idea.



Thank you for your attention in this matter

Sign with your name and address
